adaptedNarrationEditScript.safetyPreamble: This draft supports a quiet evening reflection; it is not medical advice, a sleep treatment, nutrition instruction, or a promise of behavioral change. You may stop at any time and seek qualified support for health or eating concerns.
script: Welcome. Let the evening be whatever it is. There is nothing to fix in this moment.
Notice one sign that your day is changing pace: a dimmer room, a slower breath, or the feeling of sitting down.
You are free to meet any need that is present. This practice does not ask you to ignore hunger, discomfort, or care.
As you close, choose a gentle next step: water, rest, nourishment, or support.
